title: Edgeware X Web3 Foundation  - Joint Funding Programme
body:
![Joint funding Programme](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/feb1f8b0-05d1-4b8f-bcf5-599a71141607.1654685368983) # Author Ramsey([Decentration](https://decentration.org))

_tl;dr... Basically, we got a Web3 Foundation grant, and so now we are structuring so that Edgeware are involved in more ongoing funding efforts with W3F._ Given that Edgeware is working on developing pallets and open source tools that will benefit wider chains, it makes clear sense to partner up with other funds that have mutual aims, namely Web3 Foundation. This has already begun with getting funded by Web3 foundation for _pallet_supersig_. ## Summary For greater cooperation between Edgeware and [Web3 Foundation](https://web3.foundation/) "Web3", [Decentration](https://decentration.org) has been working on creating a joint funding programme for the purpose of delivering value to the substrate ecosystem, and leveraging Edgeware and Kabocha as a "playground of possibilities" to incubate teams, and launch, test new pallets, tools and utilities. **Aim**

The aim is for our grassroots development ethos to permeate into the the wider ecosystem, and our growing community of chains (Edgeware, Kabocha, Beresheet, Pop-Art, etc.) will set an example and standard for how to design, build, launch and nurture projects. **Benefit**

The benefits to Edgeware in this are manifold. Of coursr brings Edgeware closer to funding the most relevant projects and teams in substrate. And a key benefit is that it alleviates some of the burden from Edgeware and Kabocha for funding things that may benefit many stakeholders in Substrate. The open-source funding model is useful but can be improved, as there is essentially a stakeholder that bears the brunt of expense, coordination and ongoing maintenance.
